name: Public Joint-Stock Company Donskoy Plant of Radiocomponents
summary: Public Joint-Stock Company Donskoy Plant of Radiocomponents engages in production of electronic components. The company engages in the production of metal-ceramic housings for assembly and sealing of integrated circuits for radio electronics industry. It specializes in the development and manufacture of ceramic parts from vacuum-dense alumina ceramics for use in machinery and consumer goods. It offers a wide range of products, such as ceramic, metal ceramic and glass-ceramic body of the 2nd and 4th types pin count 8 to 42 for the assembly and the protection of integrated circuits; metal- housing for assembly and protection of power semiconductors - diodes, thyristors; insulators with diameter from 0.8 mm to 350 mm from vacuum-tight ceramics; ceramic insulators for automotive spark plugs; ceramic catalysts used in the chemical industry. The company was formerly known as DONSKOY FACTORY OF RADIOCOMPONENTS Open Joint-Stock Company and changed its name to Public Joint-Stock Company Donskoy Plant of Radiocomponents in February 2026. Public Joint-Stock Company Donskoy Plant of Radiocomponents was founded in 1963 and is based in Donskoy, Russia.
